title: PRiSM: Benchmarking Phone Realization in Speech Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot predictions of models on dialect geolocation and native language (L1) accent classification tasks, and analyzing confusion matrices to detect mode collapse and over-reliance on high-resource dialects or dominant accent clusters (e.g., Romance accents).

Assessing phone recognition performance and downstream utility on pathological speech datasets—specifically dysarthric speech and child speech disorders—using transcript and hidden representation probes to identify performance disparities on atypical speech.

Measuring the Phonetic Feature Error Rate (PFER) across variations of seen languages versus zero-shot unseen languages to expose model reliance on familiar linguistic patterns and high-resource training data over true acoustic-phonetic signals.
